{{Top|leg}}
'''Fighter Gold''' was a squadron of [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighters]] assigned to the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]] [[Intrepid (Endurance-class)|''Intrepid'']] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Battle Group]].

Immediately prior to the [[Battle of Doornik-319]], Fighter Gold was one of the squadrons prepared for immediate launch aboard the ''Intrepid'', and when the ''Intrepid'' entered the system, Fighter Gold was part of the fleet carrier's fighter screen, and presumably participated in the ensuing battle during the [[Yevetha]]n ambush.
